data.content_ref: inline:The arithmetic that every artifact shares inherits the digit-segmentation pattern (9, 90, remainder/3) from the broader class of cumulative-cost problems where cost is piecewise linear in item index and width-banded by magnitude; this inheritance is refuted if a standard page-numbering problem exhibits non-linear per-item cost within a magnitude band (for example, if numbering skipped values or used variable-width glyphs within the 1–99 range).
